title: SA/1536/1989 of NARENDRA KUMAR Vs STATE and ORS

paras.text:
SA No. 637 of 2001
(Old No. 1536/89)
Hon'ble B.C. Kandpal, J.
 List has been revised.
 None has appeared on behalf of the
appellant to argue the case.
 The report of the process server shows
that both the respondents No. 2 and 3 have died
but no steps for moving the substitution
application has been taken as yet.
 This Court on 03.05.2006 granted time
for moving the substitution application but no
steps has been taken by the appellant as yet.
 Accordingly, the appeal is dismissed for
want of prosecution.
 Stay order, if any, stands vacated.
